item.summary: feat(qa): add a standalone Telegram Desktop recorder with a prebaked desktop image (#125186) Records native Telegram Desktop from a digest-pinned prebaked image: a ready desktop in ~12s with no per-lease apt installs or downloads, which also removes the dpkg-lock failures that killed recent runs. The recorder only records; callers drive the turn and supply the TDLib driver used for QR authorization. Nothing in this repository invokes it yet - routing the Mantis Telegram Desktop Proof workflow through it is a follow-up.
